#  THE LOTS OF ROSSVILLE, ILLINOIS - FROM THE COUNTY'S OWN RECORDS
#
#  794 cadastral parcels, pulled from Vermilion County's property service
#  (gis.cityofdanville.org/arcgis/rest/services/Property/Property), which is the
#  Supervisor of Assessment's own boundary data. Raw download kept at
#  tools/rossville-parcels.geojson so this file can be rebuilt.
#
#  Converted to metres about the crossing of Chicago Street and Attica Street -
#  the same origin the street grid uses - and offset so that crossing sits at
#  750,1335 on the map.
#
#  THESE ARE NOT INVENTED AND NOT AVERAGED. The median lot is 1,011 square
#  metres: 26.3m of frontage by 51.1m deep, which is a quarter acre and is what
#  a village lot in eastern Illinois actually is. The generated ones before this
#  were 13m by 7m - the frontage happened to be close and the depth was out by a
#  factor of seven, which is why the houses stood in a row down the middle of
#  blocks that should have been back gardens.
#
#  One parcel per line, as a closed ring of x,y points.
